name: NBA Rivals
summary:
Officially licensed by the NBA, NBA Rivals features global ambassador Jimmy Butler, one of the league’s top superstars. Combining highly realistic visuals with innovative gameplay, the game lets you showcase your skills in both 3v3 street battles and 5v5 authentic NBA matchups.

Beyond the court, you can also take charge of the player-driven Free Trade Market, buying low and selling high to build your dream roster. From on-court mechanics to off-court strategy, experience the perfect blend of skill-based action and tactical team management—and dominate the league your way!
